title: How to Build a Feedback Tool
summary: Build a customer feedback tool, NPS survey, or feature voting board in under an hour — database, dashboard, and notifications included. No $300/mo SaaS needed.
body_markdown: Yes. Describe the public board, voting mechanics, and admin panel to Blink and it generates the full stack. The difference from Canny: your board runs on your domain, in your database, with your branding — and there's no per-tracked-user pricing. If you need Canny's enterprise features (SSO, CRM integrations, dedicated support), Canny is still the right choice. If you need the functionality without the pricing, build it.
